tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Fixed-fare Schiphol transfers (route ids, per-car prices), private tours (tour ids, durations, per-car prices), vehicles with passenger and luggage limits, and booking rules. No side effects.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Exact price and rule check for one ride (no booking, no email, no payment). Returns the total, any online deposit and a quoteToken valid for 15 minutes. Per type: fixed needs routeId, direction and address; custom needs pickup and dropoff; tour needs tourIds and pickup. Fixed fares only apply inside

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Books the quoted ride. Call ONLY after the customer has seen the quoted total and deposit and has explicitly approved it and accepted the Terms (https://www.jetcabams.nl/terms.html). Send exactly the same ride fields as the get_quote call plus its unchanged quoteToken and the customer's real contact

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Where a booking request stands: waiting for the customer's email confirmation, waiting for the driver, payment pending (with the payment link), confirmed, completed or cancelled. Needs the bookingId from request_booking and the customer's email.

tools.name: change_booking
tools.description: Changes an existing booking at the customer's request (date, time, address, pickup, drop-off, passengers, luggage, car, flight, notes). tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels a booking at the customer's explicit request. Requests not yet confirmed by the driver and unpaid tours are cancelled at once (the customer gets an email). findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "cancel_booking" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote, request_booking, get_booking_status, change_booking · Private data: list_services, request_booking · Public sink: get_quote, request_booking, get_booking_status, change_booking, cancel_booking · Destructive: change_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote, request_booking, get_booking_status, change_booking · Private data: list_services, request_booking · Public sink: get_quote, request_booking, get_booking_status, change_booking, cancel_booking · Destructive: change_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
